summary: Giant Sparrow and Annapurna's What Remains of Edith Finch is a short first-person anthology/narrative exploration game with current PC and current-gen console routes.

entries.title: What Remains of Edith Finch
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, or native PS5/Xbox Series X|S for console 4K/60 capture

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC settings route or native current-gen console 4K/60

primary.why: PC is the most flexible capture route for What Remains of Edith Finch, while PS5/Xbox Series X|S versions provide native 4K/60 console routes. Since the game is short and story-structured, archive notes should focus on build, platform, control, and chapter/ending state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release, or PS5/Xbox Series X|S if a console-native 4K/60 route is preferred. Record platform/build, graphics settings, controller/keyboard state, chapter/story segment, subtitles, accessibility, completion state, and whether current-gen console performance was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if console-native capture is preferred.
secondary.why: PC remains the most flexible archive route.
They have lower capture/control ceilings than PC/current-gen console.

all_releases.fidelity: Original release family with PC as preferred capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: flexible capture and current storefront access.

all_releases.fidelity: Native current-gen console route with 4K/60 support.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC and current-gen console routes are both strong; choose based on capture workflow.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record chapter/story segment and do not spoil/skip story vignettes when comparing versions.
